questions.stem: A tea company wants to know where in India it can buy leaf and how India's standing compares with the rest of the world. (a) Name the major tea-producing states. (b) Name the states that also grow tea, and state where India stood among the producers of tea in 2020.

markingPoints.description: Names Assam, the hills of Darjeeling and Jalpaiguri districts in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu and Kerala as the major tea-producing states
Names Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Meghalaya, Andhra Pradesh and Tripura as states that also grow tea
States that in 2020 India was the second largest producer of tea after China

answerScheme.modelAnswer: (a) The major tea-producing states are Assam, the hills of Darjeeling and Jalpaiguri districts in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu and Kerala. (b) Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Meghalaya, Andhra Pradesh and Tripura also grow tea. In 2020 India was the second largest producer of tea after China.

questions.stem: A jute mill in Assam must write up its raw material plan in steps before the season begins. Set out, in steps: (i) the name by which jute is known and the kind of land and soil it grows well in, (ii) the temperature condition it needs while growing, (iii) the states where jute is grown most, and (iv) the items made from jute.

markingPoints.description: Gives the growing conditions as well-drained fertile soils in the flood plains where soils are renewed every year
States that high temperature is required during the time of growth
Names the five major jute producing states: West Bengal, Bihar, Assam, Odisha and Meghalaya
Lists the jute goods as gunny bags, mats, ropes, yarn, carpets and other artefacts

answerScheme.modelAnswer: 1. Jute is known as the golden fibre. It grows well on well-drained fertile soils in the flood plains where soils are renewed every year. 2. High temperature is required during the time of growth. 3. The major jute producing states are West Bengal, Bihar, Assam, Odisha and Meghalaya. 4. It is used in making gunny bags, mats, ropes, yarn, carpets and other artefacts.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
Ramesh has been hired to run a fruit and vegetable warehouse. His new boss tells him that in 2020 India was the second largest producer of fruits and vegetables in the world after China, and that India grows both tropical and temperate fruits. Ramesh must label every crate by place of origin. Mangoes arrive from Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal, while oranges come from Nagpur and Cherrapunjee in Meghalaya, and bananas from Kerala, Mizoram, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu. Apples, pears, apricots and walnuts arrive from Jammu and Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh.

(a) Ramesh has to record India's standing among world producers. Name the country India comes after, the year in which this position was measured, and the two kinds of fruit India grows. (b) Check the places of origin given for the fruit in the warehouse. Which four fruits can be supplied from exactly the same two places, and name those two places.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: (a) China; 2020; tropical fruits and temperate fruits. (b) Apples, pears, apricots and walnuts — all four come from exactly the same two places, Jammu and Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh.
